page_title: NIC 1-1 LIL | Nice v Lille 11/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) commits a foul and Benoit Bastien immediately signals a free kick.

90+3' 1 - 1 Superbly taken set piece! Angel Gomes takes the free kick and sends a cross into the six-yard box. Bafode Diakite (Lille) flicks the ball lightly with his head under the goalkeeper's legs. Marcin Bulka can't react quickly enough and the score changes to 1:1.
90+3' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Jordan Lotomba (Nice). Lille earn a free kick.
90+3' Lille are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
90+1' A crossfield pass from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
87' Pablo Rosario (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
83' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) takes it short.
81' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) replacing Remy Cabella.
81' Terem Moffi (Nice) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Hicham Boudaoui replaces him.
80' Substitution. Hakon Arnar Haraldsson makes way for Yusuf Yazici (Lille).
79' Terem Moffi (Nice) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
77' Ismaily (Lille) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
76' Ismaily (Lille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
75' Evann Guessand (Nice) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.

74' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Benoit Bastien with no other option than to blow for a foul.
72' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Marcin Bulka has no trouble gathering it.

70' Marcin Bulka pulls off a great save to deny Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
68' Marcin Bulka (Nice) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
67' Substitution. Edon Zhegrova (Lille) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Alan Virginius walks off.
66' The game is interrupted now, Marcin Bulka (Nice) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
66' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) sees the run of Jonathan David and tries to slip the ball to him, but Marcin Bulka sees the danger and gathers.
65' Terem Moffi (Nice) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
62' Evann Guessand (Nice) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
61' Carlos Baleba will be replaced by Angel Gomes (Lille).
58' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Gaetan Laborde walks off the pitch to be replaced by Evann Guessand (Nice).
57' Here is a change. Khephren Thuram is going off and Francesco Farioli gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Rosario (Nice).
57' Substitution. Jeremie Boga is replaced by Sofiane Diop (Nice).
57' Terem Moffi (Nice) fails to turn the rebound in as the goalkeeper pulls off a great save to keep him out.
55' Khephren Thuram (Nice) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
49' Rough tackle by Remy Cabella (Lille). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Jonathan David (Lille) dribbles into the box, but Marcin Bulka is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
46' Francesco Farioli makes a half-time substitution. Jordan Lotomba comes on in place of Youcef Atal (Nice).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Tiago Santos (Lille) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Bastien and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
45+2' Great individual play by Tiago Santos (Lille) ends with a shot from distance that flies high over the bar.
45+2' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
45+1' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is cautioned by the referee.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Terem Moffi (Nice) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
42' Remy Cabella (Lille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

41' Jonathan David (Lille) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the roof of the net, but Marcin Bulka is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lille.
39' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Jeremie Boga (Nice) offside.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) was quite harsh and Benoit Bastien didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Morgan Sanson (Nice) commits a rough foul. Benoit Bastien stops the game and makes a call.
35' Youcef Atal (Nice) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
34' Remy Cabella (Lille) takes the corner which is cleared.
33' An attempted cross from Alan Virginius (Lille) is cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Lille will take a corner.
32' Melvin Bard (Nice) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
32' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Benjamin Andre (Lille). Benoit Bastien saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
31' Melvin Bard (Nice) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' A pass from Tiago Santos (Lille) is intercepted by Marcin Bulka and the move breaks down.
28' Jeremie Boga (Nice) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
26' Tiago Santos (Lille) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
24' Looks like Tiago Santos (Lille) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
20' Khephren Thuram (Nice) has a goal ruled out for offside!
18' 1 - 0 GOAL! Gaetan Laborde (Nice) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Lucas Chevalier, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:0.
18' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Carlos Baleba (Lille).
16' Remy Cabella (Lille) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Morgan Sanson (Nice) shoots from the free kick towards the goal, but mishits the shot as it goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty!
12' Carlos Baleba (Lille) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Nice.
11' The resulting set piece from Nice is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

11' Jeremie Boga (Nice) shoots the rebound towards the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows the goalkeeper to pull off a stunning save. The ball goes out of play. Nice are awarded a corner kick.
8' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
7' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Nice will have a corner.
6' Tiago Santos (Lille) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The linesman signals a throw-in for Nice.
5' Benjamin Andre (Lille) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
3' Carlos Baleba (Lille) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance low towards the middle of the goal, but Marcin Bulka is alert and makes a decent save.

2' A cross by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is out of play. Nice will take a throw-in.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Lille will take the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien will officiate today.
